rawContent: @IsaiahTalton @iproposethis I agree with this. The #metoo movement is needed. Women have not been heard and should be, I just feel there is an extra venom towards Black men. So far, only two people have in prison and jail - Cosby and R.Kelly. This is a by product of racism/white supremacy.

@iproposethis I believe Gooding is dirty - there are too many women from too many parts of the country saying similar things. My thing is with the #Metoo movement, only two men are in jail and they happen to be Black?
@iproposethis With that being said, I don’t 100% agree with that person. #metoo is needed, I just don’t want the face of it being a Black man.

@iproposethis 2. The thing that bothers me is that when we look at the documentaries - Surviving R. Kelly, the Michael Jackson doc, and the upcoming Russel Simmions, they are all about Black men. With #metoo, the race angle has to be investigated.
